europe_now.title: Belgium faces its largest wildfire on record, turns to Europe for air support
europe_now.summary: Belgium is battling its biggest wildfire in modern history, scorching thousands of hectares and prompting large-scale evacuations. The crisis has drawn European Union assistance, including aircraft support, as firefighters work to contain the blaze.

sources.headline: Belgium faces its largest wildfire on record, turns to Europe for air support

europe_now.title: NATO fighter jet shoots down drone over Romania
europe_now.summary: A NATO fighter jet intercepted and destroyed an unmanned drone that violated Romanian airspace, highlighting ongoing security concerns in the region. The incident underscores the alliance's commitment to defending member states against aerial threats.

sources.headline: NATO fighter jet shoots down drone over Romania

top_stories.title: Stolen Renaissance paintings recovered in Italy
top_stories.summary: Italian authorities have retrieved four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings that were stolen from a museum. The artworks, valued at millions of euros, include works by Renoir, Cézanne and Matisse.

sources.headline: Four 'extraordinary' Renaissance paintings stolen from Italian museum
Italy recovers millions of euros worth of stolen Renoir, Cézanne and Matisse paintings

top_stories.title: Polish bus crash in Hungary kills twelve
top_stories.summary: A Polish pilgrimage bus overturned on a Hungarian highway, resulting in twelve fatalities. The incident prompted emergency response and investigations into the cause of the accident.

sources.headline: At least 12 killed as Polish pilgrimage bus overturns in Hungary
Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway

top_stories.title: Flood in northwestern Spain causes deaths and injuries
top_stories.summary: Heavy rains caused a flood in rural northwestern Spain, killing two people and injuring two babies. The disaster prompted emergency services to respond and assess the damage.
